manifest.title: Coupled Frame-Entrenchment Failure Application Cases Graph
manifest.description: Token-efficient case graph. Each case stores compact facts plus typed diagnostic-presence, absence, intervention, and verdict relations. It offloads narrative burden to the glossary and governing ontology.

relation_vocabulary.definition: links a case to an ontology concept

nodes.label: CFEF ontology anchor
nodes.definition: Reference to the governing ontology.

nodes.label: H: human ontological constraint
nodes.definition: The active human representation omits, conflates, mislevels, or misbounds relevant structure.

nodes.label: F: inadequate formulation
nodes.definition: The task is communicated through that limiting representation.

nodes.label: M: corrective reconstructibility
nodes.definition: The model can plausibly generate or investigate corrective alternatives.

nodes.label: C: frame-conditioned assistance
nodes.definition: The model assists inside the supplied frame.

nodes.label: R: local success
nodes.definition: The assistance produces coherent or locally useful results.

nodes.label: E: recursive entrenchment
nodes.definition: The result increases frame authority, elaboration, switching cost, or persistence.

nodes.label: K: avoidable burden
nodes.definition: The frame generates avoidable labor, complexity, error, delay, or risk.

nodes.label: Frame audit
nodes.definition: Recover objective and invariants, classify constraints, generate rivals, and test them.

nodes.label: Justified refusal to reframe
nodes.definition: Preserve or temporarily prioritize the operative frame because a guard condition applies.
